purpose: Teach: バイヤー/打診/催促/充て/固める/アシスト/前文/一筋

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察の、本気で、絶対、バイヤー、絶対、装ったおとり捜査、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're running an undercover sting operation with a disguised buyer. We're moving forward on this seriously, and we're grateful for your cooperation.
lines.style: Measured official tone. Clear enunciation on key procedural terms. Warm underneath the formality—this is a genuine partnership, not a lecture. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察様より、本気で、絶対、合同訓練の、絶対、打診、絶対、いただきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We received a proposal from the police about conducting a joint training exercise. We're very grateful for the opportunity.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Slight nod in the voice—confirming receipt and buy-in. Genuine warmth, not performative. Keeps pace with the officer's steadiness.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 未払いの罰金、本気で、絶対、催促、絶対、警察、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're also following up on an outstanding fine. The police department is actively pursuing collection, and we appreciate your attention to this.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery. No edge, no apology—just factual. Professional distance. The slight pause before 'collection' gives weight without harshness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の予算、本気で、絶対、防犯機器に、絶対、充てる、絶対、計画です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. Our plan is to allocate company budget toward improved security equipment and training.
lines.style: Clear and direct. Slight emphasis on 'plan'—showing initiative. Warm but efficient. The kind of person who listens and acts on what he hears.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 証拠を、本気で、絶対、固める、絶対、よう、絶対、警察、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're strengthening the evidence record to support the investigation. The department is moving methodically, and we're committed to that standard.
lines.style: Deliberate pacing. Quiet weight on 'evidence' and 'methodically'—showing respect for the process. No rush. Professional conviction, not urgency.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察様の捜査、本気で、絶対、当社も、絶対、アシスト、絶対、させていただきます、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We'll do everything we can to assist the police investigation. Your team can count on us.
lines.style: Direct and sincere. Firm but not stiff. The tone of someone making a real commitment, not just saying the right thing. Slight lean forward in the voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察規則の、本気で、絶対、前文、絶対、改定、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're revising our internal security protocols to align with police department standards and best practices.
lines.style: Steady, methodical. Emphasis on 'align'—showing he understands this is collaborative, not dictated. Professional, competent. No defensiveness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、防犯意識、絶対、一筋に、絶対、高めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're ensuring all staff receive training to raise their awareness of security threats and prevention. It's a priority for us.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Not hurried, but clearly committed. The voice of someone who means what he says. Slight emphasis on 'priority'—genuine organizational commitment.
